dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL targeting disk-based ISAM files; Portuguese-language identifiers and month names; decimal-point is comma (Brazilian locale); Screen Section with BLANK SCREEN, LINE/COL, USING clauses typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL
evidence: Portuguese identifiers: Numero, Nome, Endereco, Cidade, Telefone, Livros

purpose.domain_detail: Video rental store (Video Locadora) member/associate registration system
purpose.summary: This program manages a member (socio) registry for a video rental store. It provides a menu-driven interface for inclusion, alteration, exclusion, and lookup of members by name or address, using an indexed ISAM file. The program is written in Brazilian Portuguese.

notable_features: Screen Section with BLANK SCREEN, LINE/COL, HIGHLIGHT, USING
ISAM indexed file with alternate record keys (Nome, Endereco) with duplicates
Portuguese-language identifiers and month name table
Redefines clause for month name table
Dynamic access mode on indexed file
verdict.notes: The source contains a non-ASCII character in the month name 'Mar	z	o' (likely 'Março' with a Windows-1252 or ISO-8859-1 encoding artifact rendered in UTF-8). The program appears to be a student or hobbyist exercise for a Brazilian Portuguese video rental shop membership system. No EXEC SQL or CICS. Dialect is uncertain between GnuCOBOL and older Micro Focus Personal COBOL for DOS, but the file-id syntax and Screen Section style lean toward GnuCOBOL or compatible.
